t: This is the Bishopsgate Parish Memorial, a war memorial. Two of the people it commemorates are named in the records. One is Field Marshal Lord Kitchener, who rose to prominence through his imperial campaigns and the Second Boer War, and who played a central role early in the First World War. The other is Jack Cornwell, known as Boy Cornwell, who showed gallantry at the Battle of Jutland. He died aged just sixteen, and was awarded the Victoria Cross after his death.
